name: Beetle, Giant Round
appearance: A Large, round-bodied beetle with a domed carapace, six legs and paired antennae.

Trait.name: Knockdown Charge
Trait.effectNote: Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature. The beetle can force it to make a DC 12 STR save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the beetle can Bite it once as a bonus action.

Reaction.name: Poison Spit
Reaction.effectNote: When the beetle takes damage, it can spit a 15-ft. line. Creatures in the line make a DC 12 DEX save. Failure deals 1d6 poison damage and leaves the creature poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves damage and prevents the condition. The creature can end the condition with a DC 12 CON save at the end of each of its turns.

Mount.name: Climbing and burrowing
Mount.effectNote: A rider has to pass a WIS (Animal Handling) check to stay on a climbing or burrowing mount. The DC starts at 10 and increases by 1 for every 5 ft. the mount moves that way.

Mount.name: Secure Saddle
Mount.effectNote: Fastening this saddle takes two rounds. It grants advantage on checks and saves to stay mounted.

notes: Black Flag fixed values are Perception 10 and Stealth 11. Ability modifiers are STR +3, DEX +1, CON +2, INT −5, WIS +0 and CHA −4. No languages.
The book calls it Round Beetle, Giant and prints CR 1/4. This profile uses the printed fraction for the existing Beetle, Giant Round entry, whose index value is 0.3.
Source: Kobold Press, Campaign Builder: Dungeons & Ruins (2025), pp. 28–29.

name: Earthworm, Giant
appearance: A Large earthworm with a long, legless, segmented body.

Trait.name: Water Aversion
Trait.effectNote: The worm refuses to enter bodies of water. If water fills its burrow while it is digging, it must Dash away from the water on its next turn.

Action.name: Thrash (Recharge 4–6)
Action.effectNote: Every creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 DEX save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and success halves it. A creature that fails by 5 or more also falls prone.

Reaction.name: Reflexive Writhe
Reaction.effectNote: If the worm can see a creature attacking it, it can raise its AC to 14 against that attack.
